name: link-mirror
description: Reconcile NTFS links between a source tree and a mirrored copy: scan, diff, recreate missing symlinks/junctions (and optionally hardlink groups) with verbatim targets and link-own timestamps
long_description: After a file-level mirror (robocopy, Beyond Compare, preserve COPY) the destination holds the regular files but not the links. link-mirror scans the source for every link object (walk backend, or MFT/USN enumeration when elevated), diffs against the destination, and recreates what is missing -- same kind, verbatim target bytes (relative unresolved, broken unrepaired), link-own timestamps at 100ns precision, parent-directory times restored. Dry-run by default; additive only; conflicts reported, never overwritten; idempotent. Hardlink reconciliation (--hardlinks recreate) is opt-in and sha256-guarded. Thin CLI over dazzle_preservelib.linkmirror.
